sources.notes: Retrospective official history: Odyssey launched October 20, 1994 and CR-V in 1995; new recreational vehicles helped the Japanese business recover. Does not use the later 36-month Odyssey sales milestone.

Original company release: 1996 sales $3.002 billion, up 5%; net earnings $199.912 million. Board games, CD-ROM games and Star Wars products contributed. The release’s 15% earnings-growth figure excludes a prior-year charge and is not used.

Original annual report, publication day not established. Net income was $4.178 billion in 1995; services revenue rose from $9.715 billion to $12.714 billion; Lotus was acquired July 5, 1995. Indexed report text consulted. Some windows end before the report was published; only the earlier business events and fiscal results are described.
